Keys to the City

SocialFit · Origins

From the SocialFit founding team
An invitation to Keys to the City.
01 · The longing

Home is not measured in bricks, space or years.

It is felt in the moments when you feel held: in a warm hug you can return to, no matter how far you roam, and in the people, places and shared rhythms that make a life feel truly yours.

SocialFit helps you deepen your roots in Dubai and opens up the connections, experiences and possibilities that give you the wings to flourish.

02 · The intelligence

A trust graph for real life.

SocialFit learns the patterns across people, communities, places and experiences, then uses real friend-of-a-friend pathways to find the combinations most likely to become meaningful.

03 · The possibility

Not another community. The fabric between them.

SocialFit connects circles that currently sit apart, giving Dubai a social layer with the breadth of a city and the intimacy of a trusted introduction. This is how more people can find their way into friendships, rituals and communities that make Dubai feel like home.

The intelligence finds the fit, people create the belonging.

01 · A considered invitation

Your name reached us through trust.

Someone saw not only what you bring to a room, but the people, ideas and possibilities that gather around you. This invitation is personal.

02 · The company you will keep

You are being considered for rare company.

Origins gathers Dubai's thoughtful connectors, builders, creators and culture-shapers. People whose judgement carries weight, whose generosity draws others in and whose presence makes the city feel more human.

03 · Your place in the beginning

Help define the spirit of SocialFit.

If selected, you will shape its first trusted circle and open the door for three remarkable people. Wherever SocialFit goes next, you will always be part of where it began.

Philia Founder Key

Apply for a Founder Key.

Confirm your details below to submit your Founder Key application. We read every application individually because every person helps shape how the network will feel. If selected, we will send your private onboarding link and unique code. You will have 24 hours from the moment the code reaches you to claim your Founder Key.

What your Key can make possible

You will not only enter the network. You will open the door for others.

During onboarding, you will receive three Philia Keys to nominate three people who could help Dubai feel warmer, more connected and more like home. Origins Founder Key holders are the only members in the city entrusted with this privilege, and may request additional Keys for others they believe would strengthen the network.

Privacy notice

P Labs is the data controller. By submitting this form, you are applying for a Philia Founder Key. P Labs will process your application answers, name, email and WhatsApp number to validate this invitation, assess your application and, if selected, deliver your private onboarding link and unique code. We also record your Dubai residency confirmation, nomination acknowledgement, optional featured-profile preference and Founder Key contact consent. Your contact details will not be displayed to other members. Data may be handled by authorised providers supporting secure hosting, communications and verification. You may withdraw your request or ask for access, correction or deletion by emailing privacy@philia.life.
